# Reference review trigger

::: {.hub-record-hero .hub-idea-hero}
<p class="hub-idea-status">Idea · High priority · 2/9 readiness fields complete</p>

<p class="hub-takeaway">Flag generated reference answers that need more evidence or a human check before guiding a ranking.</p>
<p>A selective review trigger could reduce avoidable reference failures without reviewing every request.</p>

<p class="hub-next-action">Define the local trigger features and acceptance rule.</p>
:::


<details class="hub-details">
<summary>Evidence and current knowledge</summary>
## How does it work?

- Measure signals that indicate a generated reference may be unreliable.
- Route flagged references to grounding or human review.
- Compare the trigger with always-review and never-review controls.

## What do we know?

The existing audits motivate selective escalation, but the local trigger and its
acceptance rule are not yet frozen. Completed E5 refinement evidence is recorded
as a study, not mislabeled as a future ready test.
</details>
